facts.business: Xchanging Solutions Limited is an Information Technology (IT) services provider with operations in India and USA through its subsidiary Xchanging Solutions (USA) Inc.
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions proposed between Xchanging Solutions (USA) Inc. (wholly owned subsidiary) and DXC Technology Services LLC, and between Xchanging Solutions (USA) Inc. and Xchanging Technology Services India Private Limited (promoter holding 19.16%). Approval sought for FY 2026-27. Materiality threshold is 10% of annual consolidated turnover i.e. Rs. 20 Crores approximately.
